changes.before: Huang led the army in person and captured Xiangping.
changes.after: Huang campaigned against Liaodong in person and captured Xiangping.
changes.reason: Restore Liaodong, the target of the personal campaign (自征遼東).

changes.sourceChinese: 仁所署居就令劉程以城降，新昌人張衡執縣宰以降。
changes.before: Liu Cheng, whom Ren had installed at Juqiu, yielded the town, while Zhang Heng of Xinchang seized the magistrate and capitulated.
changes.after: Liu Cheng, whom Ren had installed as magistrate of Jujiu, surrendered the town, while Zhang Heng of Xinchang seized the county head and capitulated.
changes.reason: Restore the office 令 and render 居就 as Jujiu in both English fields and repeated uses.
